$comment: Accepted survivors for scripts/mutation-check.mjs (#192): mutants on changed lines of .claude/hooks/*.mjs or scripts/*.mjs that no test kills because the change is equivalent (behaves the same) or is harmless over-refusal (the guard refuses more, never less). An entry matches on file, mutator, original and replacement text (whitespace collapsed), not on line number. Each entry needs a reason. The check prints a ready-made entry for every new survivor; add one only after deciding a test cannot or should not catch it. A survivor that lets the guard allow a command it should refuse is never accepted: add a test. See docs/quality.md.

survivors.reason: Equivalent: git quotes a diff path that contains a double quote, so a path from git ends in a quote only when it also starts with one.
Equivalent in readJson: with no encoding readFileSync returns a Buffer, and JSON.parse reads it as UTF-8 text, so the parsed ledger or report is the same.
Equivalent: with GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY unset, appendFileSync(undefined) throws and the catch ignores it, so nothing is written either way and the exit status does not change.
Equivalent: process.kill sends its default signal, SIGTERM, when the signal is an empty string, so the budget still sends SIGTERM first.

Equivalent in `if (detached) killGroup('SIGKILL')`: without a budget Stryker is not detached, so its pid names no process group, process.kill(-pid) fails with ESRCH and the catch ignores it; nothing is killed either way.

Equivalent in what is counted: left is exactly 0 only when the check lands on the deadline millisecond; the group then starts and a 0 ms timer cuts it at once, and a cut group's mutants are not counted, same as a group that is not run.
